nodes.summary: Let $p$ and $q$ be real numbers with $0 < q < p \le 1$, and for $k \in \mathbb{N}$ put $[k] = (p^k - q^k)/(p - q)$. Define real numbers $S(n, k)$ for $n, k \in \mathbb{N}$ by $S(0, 0) = 1$, $S(0, k) = 0$ for $k \ge 1$, $S(n + 1, 0) = 0$, and, for $k \ge 1$, $S(n + 1, k) = p^{n + 1 - k} q^{k - 1} S(n, k - 1) + [k] \, S(n, k)$, where the exponent $n + 1 - k$ is read as $0$ when $k > n + 1$.
